conservation.technical_description: Framing, Backing, and Hanging Hardware: The painting is installed in a 2006 reproduction frame of the artists’ preferred style “clam-shell” metal leaf over grey bole. Acid-free Fome-Cor panel backing strainer and hardware. The glazing is 3mm Optium RF acrylic with 1/8 frame space standoff.

remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Note: See Gallery photograph. O'Keeffe dates this 1930." Pictured in 1931 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 46. Reproduced in *The Springfield Daily–Republican* (March 1935). See cat. nos. 1822, 1823. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
